cause_quote: The initial Side chat question input used `?disabled=${!this.connected || this.companion.pendingQuestion !== null}`, which disabled typing whenever a question was pending.
user_saw: Users could not type a follow-up question in Side chat until the current answer finished.
summary: The fix keeps the Side chat question box editable with its normal placeholder during an answer and continues to block sending until the answer finishes.
reasoning: The commit that introduced the Side chat composer already disabled its question input while an answer was pending. I checked the later turn-history refactor and confirmed that it carried the same restriction forward using the new pending-turn state.
